notes.title: CLAIRE A LA MODE DEMO - Next Fest Gameplay
notes.content:
Try out our Demo to get a taste of Claire a la Mode!

[previewyoutube=I1fJ69OjncI;full][/previewyoutube]

Add Claire a la Mode to your Wishlist to be notified on release!
Team up with a friend or go it alone in a sugar-high adventure! Bake your dessert masterpiece and collect new bakers as you rise through a high-stakes bake-off full of cheaters. Fend off their decadent lackeys and against all odds, come out on top in a worldwide baking frenzy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292860/Claire_a_la_Mode/
